-- Scrolling Frame - Theme Applied

scrollingFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 60)
scrollingFrame.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_BTN_DARK_GREY
scrollingFrame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 0, 0) -- Darker red border for depth
scrollingFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 6
scrollingFrame.ScrollBarImageColor3 = COLOR_PRIMARY_RED
scrollingFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 340) -- Adjusted for 5 buttons + padding
scrollingFrame.Parent = mainFrame

local uiListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
uiListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
uiListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 12)
uiListLayout.Parent = scrollingFrame

-- Function to create stylized buttons - Theme Applied (Red/Black)
local function createButton(name, text, layoutOrder)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 55)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_BTN_DARK_GREY
    btn.BorderColor3 = COLOR_PRIMARY_RED
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 1
    btn.TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT_WHITE
    btn.TextSize = 15
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    btn.Text = text
    btn.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
    btn.Parent = scrollingFrame

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    corner.Parent = btn
    
    -- Hover effect
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_PRIMARY_RED}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {TextColor3 = COLOR_BG_BLACK}):Play()
    end)
    
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_BTN_DARK_GREY}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT_WHITE}):Play()
    end)
    
    return btn
end
